plainTranslation: With Composite Pluto in the 11th house, you may struggle over power and control of your dreams together. You can dream big together, and feel you can do far more together than you can apart, making a big contribution to the world, as long as you allow one another to be yourselves. You can have more a more powerful network together, and transform the dreams you have for your future together.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
